description: This file contains the implementation of the Language class within the Opencart CMS, specifically in the Catalog Controller Startup namespace. It manages language loading, setting default language, switching languages based on request parameters, and overriding language defaults through hooks. The class extends a base Controller class and interacts with the localization and configuration subsystems.
published: Opencart	ext	o be filled if the class or its methods are explicitly marked as public API symbols

classes.name: Language
classes.description: A controller class responsible for managing the language selection and loading process during application startup in the Opencart system.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Initializes available languages, sets the default language, and switches language based on request parameters. Loads language files accordingly.

methods.name: after
methods.description: Provides a hook to override or extend language loading behavior after the main process, adjusting language paths dynamically based on route, prefix, and language code.
